import numpy as np
lines = ax1.get_lines()
sheet_names = ['R1-260326-1', 'R1-260716-1']
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if i >= len(sheet_names): break
    x_data = line.get_xdata()
    y_data = line.get_ydata()
    # Find indices closest to 200 and 450
    idx_200 = np.argmin(np.abs(x_data - 200))
    idx_450 = np.argmin(np.abs(x_data - 450))
    w200 = y_data[idx_200]
    w450 = y_data[idx_450]
    delta_m = w200 - w450
    new_label = f"{sheet_names[i]} (Δm: {delta_m:.2f} wt%)"
    line.set_label(new_label)
ax1.legend()
